description:
An HTTPS API as a data source: a GET of the GitHub releases of a repository, the JSON
list of objects shown as rows. Needs network. See `:help dbdash-http`.

query.transform:
local out = {}
for _, r in ipairs(rs) do
  local downloads = 0
  for _, a in ipairs(r.assets or {}) do
    downloads = downloads + (a.download_count or 0)
  end
  out[#out + 1] = {
    release = r.tag_name,
    published = (r.published_at or ""):sub(1, 10),
    downloads = downloads,
    prerelease = r.prerelease,
  }
end
return { columns = { "release", "published", "downloads", "prerelease" }, rows = out }

show.title: GitHub releases
show.description:
The latest releases of `{{ args.repo }}` from `{{ meta.db_url }}`: a JSON list of
objects needs no transform; `column_list` picks and renames the fields. Change the
repository with `a`.
